_about: Liveness-watchdog thresholds for runtime/scripts/watchdog.py (issue #418). Every detection threshold and rate limit lives here so coordinators tune without code edits; watchdog.py refuses unknown keys so a typo fails loud instead of silently holding a default. Starting values are generalized from the 2026-09-14 clean-sweep tracker run (docs/runs/2026-09-14-clean-sweep-tracker.md): the R393R SPEC reviewer went 60+ min with a transcript frozen 20+ min before its nudge, and the V393R-r1 verdict worker wedged on a dead provider stream.
